description: This file implements a cron session reaper that prunes expired cron run sessions from a session store, with configurable retention and throttling to avoid excessive I/O. It includes functions for resolving retention periods, sweeping sessions, and cleaning up associated transcripts.

methods.name: resolveRetentionMs
methods.description: Determines the retention period in milliseconds based on the cron configuration, defaulting to 24 hours if not specified or invalid.

methods.name: sweepCronRunSessions
methods.description: Performs a sweep of the session store to prune expired cron run sessions, archives removed sessions, and cleans up transcripts, with throttling to limit frequency.

methods.name: resetReaperThrottle
methods.description: Resets the internal throttle timer used to limit sweep frequency, mainly for testing purposes.
